trigger_condition: User takes an oral iron supplement on consecutive days under conditions comparable to the supporting study.
population_description: Women with iron-deficiency anaemia; evidence derived from the IRON_001 study population.
recommendation_text_template: Under conditions similar to the supporting study, alternate-day oral iron dosing was associated with higher fractional iron absorption than consecutive-day dosing. This evidence is specific to the studied population and dose range.
applicability_notes: Derived from a crossover absorption study in women with iron-deficiency anaemia. Do not generalise automatically to iron-replete individuals, pregnancy, children, or other supplement doses.

trigger_condition: Black tea is drunk with, or within 60 minutes of, a meal containing non-haem iron.
population_description: Healthy adults eating a meal containing non-haem iron
recommendation_text_template: Black tea with this meal can cut the non-haem iron you absorb by about {reduction_pct}%. Having it at least an hour after eating reduces this effect.
applicability_notes: Overrides the generic polyphenol beverage rule for black tea. 60-minute window from Ahmad Fuzi 2017 (tea 1 h after the meal still inhibited about 18% vs 37% with the meal, so the effect is reduced, not removed). Adding milk does not remove the effect (Hurrell 1999).

trigger_condition: A drink with at least 20 mg total polyphenols per serving is drunk with, or within 60 minutes of, a meal containing non-haem iron.
population_description: Healthy adults eating a meal containing non-haem iron
recommendation_text_template: {drink} with this meal can reduce the non-haem iron you absorb by about {reduction_pct}%. Having it at least an hour after eating reduces this effect.
applicability_notes: Engine selects ABS_MOD_IRON_002 or ABS_MOD_IRON_003 by the drink's polyphenol dose; modifier_id holds the high-dose band. Covers coffee, cocoa and herbal teas.

trigger_condition: Meal contains at least 25 mg phytate phosphorus (about 89 mg phytate) and less than 30 mg vitamin C.
population_description: Healthy adults eating a meal containing non-haem iron
recommendation_text_template: The wholegrains, beans or seeds in this meal contain phytate, which reduces the iron you absorb by about {reduction_pct}%. Adding a vitamin C rich food such as {suggestion} counteracts it.
applicability_notes: Thresholds from Hallberg 1989 (25 mg phytate P) and Siegenberg 1991 (30 mg ascorbic acid).

trigger_condition: Meal and drinks within the meal window contain at least 165 mg calcium.
population_description: Healthy adults eating a meal containing non-haem iron
recommendation_text_template: The calcium in this meal ({calcium_sources}) can reduce the iron you absorb by about {reduction_pct}%. Having dairy at a different meal from your main iron source helps.
applicability_notes: 60-minute window is an assumption (ASSUME_004); Hallberg 1991 gave calcium with the meal. Lower priority than drinks: calcium matters for bone health and should not be cut.

trigger_condition: Coffee is drunk with, or up to 120 minutes after, a meal containing non-haem iron.
population_description: Healthy adults eating a meal containing non-haem iron
recommendation_text_template: Coffee with or after this meal can cut the non-haem iron you absorb by about {reduction_pct}%. Waiting an hour afterwards does not help, but coffee an hour before the meal had no effect.
applicability_notes: Morck 1983: no effect 1 h before; full effect 1 h after. Window end of 120 min is an assumption (no data beyond 60 min). Overrides RULE_IRON_003 for coffee. Dose from ETH 2023 (219 mg polyphenols per cup).
